findings.source_passage: The front doors spilled out onto a major intersection, and all around me bustled a humanity eager to get home to family and dinner. I only had the dinner part, but pizza awaited me.
findings.why_it_matters: The draft collapses the scene-setting into a single compressed sentence and skips the 'family and dinner / only dinner / pizza' comic rhythm that establishes Miriam's self-aware loneliness in the narrator's voice.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the 'family and dinner — I only had the dinner part, but pizza awaited me' phrasing verbatim; it is the first beat of the narrator's self-deprecating voice.

findings.source_passage: I'm just seeing my eyelids,' a hefty guy quipped. That got a laugh from us office-dwellers, a laugh that extinguished much of the exhaustion from a lot of faces.
findings.why_it_matters: The quip and the narrator's gloss ('extinguished much of the exhaustion') are the only communal, observational beat in the opening crowd scene; dropping them removes the texture that grounds Miriam in an ordinary work world before the weirdness begins.
findings.suggested_fix: Reinsert the 'eyelids' quip and the narrator's follow-on observation about the laugh extinguishing exhaustion; one sentence is sufficient.

findings.source_passage: There was something dark about his eyes that I didn't like.
findings.why_it_matters: The draft reduces this to 'eyes I didn't like,' losing the specific word 'dark,' which carries early supernatural foreshadowing weight about Blake's nature.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'something dark about his eyes' verbatim; it is the segment's first hint of the supernatural register.

findings.source_passage: She grabbed some cash from her pocket and tossed the bills into the seat beside him.
findings.why_it_matters: The draft says 'tossed a wad of bills over the seat,' changing 'into the seat beside him' to 'over the seat'; minor but loses the visual specificity of Heather's gesture.
findings.suggested_fix: Small wording fix: 'tossed the bills into the seat beside him' rather than 'over the seat.'

summary: No high-severity signature losses; the draft faithfully compresses the chapter's action and key voice lines, with three medium-level flattenings (the pizza/family comedy beat, the office crowd quip, and Blake's 'dark eyes' foreshadowing) that weaken but do not erase the segment's interpretive texture.
